items.title: 2.3 Logic as a Knowledge Representation Framework

source_refs.note: Topic 2.3 with its Tidbit, as printed (PDF 26, printed 22).

blocks.text: Logic is the science of true reasoning and is an important concept in computer science. It helps computers store, understand, and use information correctly. Using logic, complex information can be represented in a simple way.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Logic gives computers a way to “think” about facts and make decisions, almost like a brain.
